title: Aureline M5 last-supported snapshot
description: Canonical per-domain last-supported snapshot for a bundle or schema-bearing surface reaching Retired. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the exact build identity, the last-supported snapshot ref, the archival note, and the export / rollback route so no last-supported docs, schemas, or evidence are destroyed before support-note closure and export-safe archive handoff. Downstream release, install/update, support, and diagnostics surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's last-supported snapshot by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
